title: Cloak of the Weave

sources.title: Absorb Elements
markers: | description = Absorb elemental damage once per [[Short Rest]]. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you, and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

summary: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.

fields.Absorb Elements: When hit by Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, spend a Reaction to gain resistance to that element. The next weapon attack can deal 1d6 extra of that type. Existing resistance does not stack.
fields.Reported bug: The item page reports that the cloak lacks the required passive for Absorb Elements to function.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
